# NeuraCode 快速宣传指南

## 🚀 5分钟快速发布

### 1. Twitter (2分钟)
复制以下内容发布：

```
🚀 Excited to announce NeuraCode!

An open-source "second brain" for AI coding assistants.

✨ Deep codebase understanding
✨ Predictive context preparation
✨ Continuous learning
✨ 10+ AI agent support

12,500+ lines | 40+ languages | MIT license

🔗 https://github.com/kevindurant735rocket-creator/neuracode

#AI #OpenSource #CodingAssistant #RustLang
```

### 2. LinkedIn (2分钟)
复制以下内容发布：

```
I'm excited to share NeuraCode, an open-source project I've been working on!

NeuraCode gives AI coding assistants a "second brain" to truly understand your codebase.

Key features:
• Deep codebase understanding with knowledge graphs
• Predictive context preparation
• Continuous learning from your coding style
• Support for 10+ AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.)

Tech: 12,500+ lines of Rust + Python, 40+ language support

GitHub: https://github.com/kevindurant735rocket-creator/neuracode

#AI #OpenSource #RustLang #CodingAssistant #MachineLearning
```

## 💡 宣传要点

### 痛点
- AI助手不理解项目
- 需要反复解释
- 改代码不知道影响
- 上下文丢失

### 解决方案
- 代码图谱理解
- 预测性上下文
- 持续学习
- 多Agent支持

### 技术亮点
- Rust高性能
- 40+语言
- 本地运行
- 隐私安全
